title: Sony Aath Airs Jujutsu Kaisen Anime's 1st Season with Bengali Dub on April 3
content: ©芥見下々／集英社・呪術廻戦製作委員会The 'Sony Aath' television channel is streaming promotional videos for the first season of Jujutsu Kaisen. The channel will begin airing the anime with a Bengali dub on April 3 and will air an episode every weekday at 5:00 p.m. IST.The Jujutsu Kaisen television anime premiered in October 2020, and it had 24 episodes. Netflix is streaming the season in India. Ani-One began streaming all episodes of the season in India in June 2023. Anime Times began streaming the season in India in July 2024. 'Sony YAY!' began airing the season on Indian television on April 7.Jujutsu Kaisen: Execution opened in Japan on November 7. It opened in India under the title Jujutsu Kaisen: Shibuya Incident x The Culling Game Begins on February 27. Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3: The Culling Game Part 1, the first part of the third season of the anime, premiered on January 8. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in India.The "Hidden Inventory / Premature Death" compilation film opened in Japan on May 30 and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. It opened in India on January 1.The Jujutsu Kaisen 0 anime film opened in Japan in December 2021 and opened in India in June 2022. It crossed ₹5.4 crore (approximately US$681,629) in earnings in its first weekend. Amazon Prime Video added the anime film in India in December 2022 and Crunchyroll added it in India in February 2023. The second season of Jujutsu Kaisen premiered in July 2023 on MBS and TBS and 28 affiliated channels. Netflix streamed the anime season in India as it aired in Japan. Crunchyroll is also streaming the anime in India. Crunchyroll began streaming the Tamil and Hindi dubs for the season in September 2023. The second season aired for two cours (quarters of a year) for a continuous half-year run. The anime adapts both the "Hidden Inventory / Premature Death" ("Kaigyoku/Gyokusetsu") arc and the "Shibuya Incident" arc of Gege Akutami's original manga. The "Hidden Inventory / Premature Death" arc aired from July-August 2023. The "Shibuya Incident" arc started at the end of August 2023 and consisted of 18 episodes.Gege Akutami launched the manga in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in March 2018, and ended it in September 2024. Viz Media is publishing the manga digitally and in print, and Shueisha is also publishing the manga digitally on its MANGA Plus service.Sources: Sony Aath's YouTube channel via @animesourceindia

title: Macross Plus: The Movie UK Blu-ray Released on Monday
content: On Monday March 30, Anime Limited will release a standard Blu-ray edition of 1995's Macross Plus: The Movie (Macross Plus Movie Edition). The film is described as follows:"From the minds of vision creator Shōji Kawamori and co-director Shinichirō Watanabe, and featuring renowned composer Yōko Kanno, Macross Plus assembles the dream team for a thrilling piece of animation history!"In the year 2040, on the distant planet Eden, former childhood friends Isamu Dyson and Guld Bowman find themselves pitted against each other as test pilots of rival teams in a competition to decide the next generation of variable mecha fighters. The two must also deal with their own unresolved history with mutual love interest, Myung Fang Lone, who has returned as the manager of Sharon Apple, the AI pop star (virturoid) and the galaxy's biggest singing sensation. When Sharon's advanced artificial intelligence gains consciousness, Isamu, Myung, and Guld must face their turbulent past and come together as Sharon Apple becomes self-aware and takes control of the Macross battlefortress itself."Anime Limited will also release the second Blu-ray volume of Naruto Shippūden, carrying episodes 26 to 50. The Blu-ray is described as follows:"After several grueling battles, Gaara is rescued from the clutches of the evil Akatsuki! But the damage is done, and his life hangs in the balance! Back in the Village Hidden in the Leaves, Naruto gets an unwelcome surprise when he's attacked by a cold and unfeeling shinobi named Sai, who is assigned to be his new teammate. The new Team Kakashi sets out on a spying mission in Orochimaru's deadly lair. A fateful encounter brings Naruto face-to-face with his old teammate now turned enemy, Sasuke!"Crunchyroll will release a Blu-ray edition of Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time.AlphaPolis' Alpha Manga service published the manga in English under the title Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time and describes the story:"Not even a hero, Takumi Iruma gets accidentally mixed in with a group of heroes chosen to be summoned to another world. As compensation for the mix-up, a goddess offers him the right to choose any skill he wishes for! Hoping for a peaceful and quiet life that has nothing to do with fighting or going into battle, he chooses a seemingly boring creation skill. However, it turns out "alchemy" is the most powerful skill that allows him to create everything from a holy sword to flying ships! This cheat skill he unexpectedly acquired turns him into a wealthy merchant and makes him undefeatable in battles! A heartwarming adventure story about (possibly) the most powerful alchemist in another world!" Naoyuki Kuzuya (Saiyuki Gaiden, Bikkuriman 2000, Bikini Warriors) directed the anime at Studio Comet. Mitsutaka Hirota (Edens Zero, Rent-A-Girlfriend) was in charge of series script, Sayaka Anesaki (Tohai: Ura Rate Mahjong Tohai Roku) designed the characters, and Hiroshi Nakamura (Sweet Reincarnation, Oda Cinnamon Nobunaga) was in charge of music.

title: Gintama's Hideaki Sorachi, Atsushi Nakamura, Masayoshi Satoshō Each Launch New Manga in April
content: This year's 18th issue of Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine revealed on Monday that manga authors Hideaki Sorachi (Gintama), Atsushi Nakamura (Agravity Boys), and Masayoshi Satoshō (Momiji no Kisetsu) will each launch a new manga in the magazine's upcoming issues in April. Nakamura will launch the Roku no Okashina Ie (Roku's Weird House) manga in the magazine's 19th issue, which will ship on April 6. The horror home comedy centers on five young boys who are possessed by a curse at the same time. Image via Comic Natalie© Atsushi Nakamura, Shueisha Satoshō will launch the Natsu to Mushikago (Summer and Insect Cage) manga in the magazine's 20th issue on April 13. The manga's story starts when someone appears before Keiki, a boy who ran away from playing basketball. Image via Comic Natalie© Masayoshi Satoshō, Shueisha Sorachi will launch the 2-nen B-gumi Yūsha Destroyers (Year 2 Class B Hero Destroyers) manga in the magazine's 21st issue, that will ship on April 20. The manga centers on a demon king who is driven out of their castle by a hero. Image via Comic Natalie© Hideaki Sorachi, Shueisha Image via Amazon©Shuhei Tanizaki, Shueisha Additionally, the magazine published the final chapter of Shuhei Tanizaki's Gonron Egg manga (image right) on Monday. Viz Media and Shueisha's MANGA Plus service publishes the manga in English. MANGA Plus describes the manga: Human society has collapsed. The survivors are now slaves to powerful creatures known as Drakarchs. But when a young slave named Gonron meets a Drakarch egg named Oma, these two who share a cruel fate will need to work together. Retrieve the lost peace and dignity. Young man, the time to rebel is now! Tanizaki launched the manga on October 25. Shueisha published the manga's first compiled book volume on March 4. The manga's second volume and third and final volume will both ship on June 4. Nakamura's Agravity Boys manga launched in Weekly Shonen Jump in December 2019. The manga ended in the magazine in 2021, and had a concluding arc in Shueisha's Jump Giga magazine. Viz Media's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha's MANGA Plus service are released the manga in English digitally. Satoshō's Momiji no Kisetsu manga launched in Weekly Shonen Jump in May 2018, and ended in September that same year. Viz Media published the first three chapters of the manga in English as part of its "Jump Start" initiative. ©Hideaki Sorachi, ShueishaSorachi's original "science-fiction period-drama comedy" manga Gintama began in 2003 and ended in June 2019 with over 55 million copies in circulation. The manga has inspired several television anime series with 367 total episodes, as well as three previous anime films. The latest anime series premiered in July 2018. The manga has also inspired various original video anime (OVA), event anime, two live-action films, and two live-action net spinoffs. Viz Media published the manga's first 23 volumes in English. Sorachi's debut one-shot manga Dandelion first debuted in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2002, and then Shueisha published the one-shot as part of the first volume of the Gintama manga. Netflix is producing the manga's seven-episode anime adaptation that will debut on the streaming service on April 16 worldwide. Source: Weekly Shonen Jump issue 18

content: Image via One Piece franchise's X/Twitter account© Eiichiro Oda/Shueisha, Toei AnimationCrunchyroll announced on Saturday that it will begin streaming the One Piece anime's Egghead arc with Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs on March 30. The dubs for episodes 1089–1128 will begin streaming on March 30, followed by the dubs for episodes 1129–1155 in April.Crunchyroll will stream the One Piece anime's Elbaph arc in India on April 5. title: Needy Girl Overdose Anime Gets 4-Panel Manga on April 5
content: Image via Needy Girl Overdose anime's website©WSS playground / NEEDY GIRL PROJECT The official website for the television anime of WSS (Why So Serious) Playground and Xemono's Needy Girl Overdose game (known as Needy Streamer Overload in English on Steam) revealed on Sunday that the anime will have a four-panel manga adaptation titled Needyga Plus (Needy Girl Plus). Kokamumo, who has made fan music videos for the original game, as well as the music videos for the original games "Internet Overdose" and "Internet Yamero" songs, is drawing the manga. The manga will launch in the anime's official X/Twitter account on April 5, with new strips every Sunday. The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV, and Tochigi TV channels, and will stream simultaneously on the ABEMA service, on April 4 at 24:30 JST (effectively April 5 at 12:30 a.m. JST). The anime will then run on the WOWOW channel and other streaming services on April 7. A compilation of the television anime's episodes started playing at Theatre Shinjuku in Tokyo, and at Theatre Umeda in Osaka, under the title Needy Girl Overdose -Overture- on March 6. Image via Needy Girl Overdose anime's website©WSS playground / NEEDY GIRL PROJECTKaramazov, a new streamer unit that was created specifically for the anime, will feature the following cast members: Rina Kawaguchi as Purple Lollipop (center in the image in left), Karamazov's leader Satsuki Shiina as Michika Gokubara (left) Seena Hoshiki as Nechika-sama (right) Anna Nagase will also star in the anime as Kache, a vocational school student who works as a cast member at a themed concept café. WSS playground is credited for the original work in the anime. Masaoki Nakajima (New PANTY & STOCKING with GARTERBELT, Blue Archive The Animation, Azur Lane: Slow Ahead! episode director) is directing the anime at Yostar Pictures. The game's scenario writer nyalra is credited for the original idea, scenario, and supervision. nyalra also penned the lyrics of the anime's opening song. The game's Ohisashiburi is similarly credited for the original character design, and Kenji Saikai (New PANTY & STOCKING with GARTERBELT episode key animator), Akari Takei (Blue Archive Short Animation beautiful day dreamer 2nd key animator), and Umito Shimizu (Is the order a rabbit? episode 2nd key animator) are the main character designers. Additional staff members include: Art Director: Ryūta Hayashi 3D CG Artists: Kaoru Marumoto, Yume Sakai, Daisuke Katano Color Key Artist: Naoto Kondō 3D CG Animation Production: CHOTOTU Visual Effects Design: Tailor Animation Editing: Keisuke Yanagi, ACE Compositing Director of Photography: Jiann Horng Wu Music: Aiobahn +81, Sasuke Haraguchi, DÉ DÉ MOUSE Sound Director: Fumiyuki Go Sound Effects: Rei Ueno Sound Production: Bit Grooove Promotion Production Supervision: Ryōsuke Inagaki Writer nyalra gave a statement in Japanese and English in November to report that WSS playground had removed him from management and promotion of the television anime. nyalra also claimed that he has not yet received full compensation for his work, but his legal representative is reviewing and negotiating the matter. He is continuing to consult his attorneys in order to protect his creative rights and integrity. Aniplex describes the game: NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE is a multi-ending adventure game depicting 30 days in the life of a girl with an intense desire for validation who aims to become the ultimate streamer, with the support of "P". WSS playground and Xemono released the game simultaneously in English, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean on PC via Steam in January 2022, with the title Needy Streamer Overload in English, and Needy Girl Overdose in Japanese. The game has over 3 million downloads. The game is also available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5. Itaru Bonnoki (The Vampire Dies in No Time) launched a manga adaptation of the game titled Needy Girl Overdose: Run with My Sick on Akita Shoten's Manga Cross website in March 2023. The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV channels, and will stream simultaneously on the ABEMA service, on April 4 at 24:30 JST (effectively April 5 at 12:30 a.m. JST). The anime will then run on the WOWOW channel and other streaming services on April 7.
A compilation of the television anime's episodes started playing at Theatre Shinjuku in Tokyo, and at Theatre Umeda in Osaka, under the title Needy Girl Overdose -Overture- on March 6.

WSS playground and Xemono released the game simultaneously in English, Japanese, Chinese, and Korean on PC via Steam in January 2022, with the title Needy Streamer Overload in English, and Needy Girl Overdose in Japanese. The game has over 3 million downloads. The game is also available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5.
Itaru Bonnoki ( The Vampire Dies in No Time ) launched a manga adaptation of the game titled Needy Girl Overdose: Run with My Sick on Akita Shoten 's Manga Cross website in March 2023.

title: Liar Game Anime to Air for 6 Months Without Breaks
content: Image courtesy of REMOW©Kaitani Shinobu Products/Shueisha, LIAR GAME CommitteeThe television anime of Shinobu Kaitani's Liar Game manga will run for two consecutive cours (quarters of a year) or six months without breaks. The anime's cast made the announcement during the anime's stage panel in the TV Tokyo booth at the AnimeJapan 2026 convention on Sunday. REMOW introduces the series' story:A Mysterious Invitation. One Hundred Million Yen. The Game Begins.College student Nao Kanzaki suddenly receives a strange letter and a suitcase containing 100 million yen. She's been chosen to participate in the LIAR GAME—a high-stakes psychological battle where lies, deception, and betrayal reign supreme. Naïve and painfully honest, Nao quickly finds herself cornered. To survive, she turns to Shinichi Akiyama, a brilliant former con artist with unmatched intellect. As they dive deeper into the twisted game, the two must outwit opponents in a world where trusting others could be fatal. In a game built on lies, can honesty prevail?The anime stars:Saya Hitomi as Nao KanzakiTakeo Ōtsuka as Shinichi AkiyamaKazuhiro Nakaya as LeroniraNobuo Tobita as Kazuo FujisawaYōji Ueda as Mitsuo TanimuraYasutaka Tomioka as Teruyuki EdaShōya Ishige as Takahiro KikuzawaRyōsuke Asano as Hiroto KitamuraTarō Kiuchi as Tetsuzo SatoRiko Akechi as Makiko TamuraToshinari Fukamachi as Daisuke DannoNaoya Miyase as Kosuke TsunodaMisuzu Yamada as Reina NishiharaTaihi Kimura as Shingo FujitaMisano Sakai as Jun HosoeAya Gomazuru as Yuki MakiharaRyō Nishizawa as Fumio MatsubaraTaku Yashiro as Takayoshi MiuraYou Daichi as Hitomi MiyaharaYūzō Satō (Kaiji -Ultimate Survivor-, Akagi, Trillion Game, The Gene of AI) is the chief director of the anime at Madhouse, and Asami Kawano (assistant director for The Vampire Dies in No Time both seasons, episode director for Orb: On the Movements of the Earth) is directing the anime. Tatsuhiko Urahata (Baki, Baki Hanma, Monster, Muv-Luv Alternative) is writing and overseeing the series scripts, Kei Tsuchiya (Laidbackers, Trillion Game, The Gene of AI) is the character designer, and Kisuke Koizumi (The Gene of AI, My Happy Marriage, Ghost in the Shell Arise) is the sound director.The anime will premiere in Japan on TV Tokyo and its affiliates on April 6 at 24:00 (effectively April 7 at 12:00 a.m.).Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide (excluding Japan and China) and host the world premiere screening of the anime's first two episodes at this year's Sakura-Con event in Seattle on April 5 at 1:00 p.m. PDT. AMEDIATEKA is distributing the anime in the Russian Federation.The manga ran from 2005 to January 2015 in Shueisha's Weekly Young Jump magazine. Shueisha published the manga's 19th and final compiled book volume in May 2015. Kaitani launched a new short serialization for the manga titled Liar Game: The Last Game in Shueisha's Grand Jump Mucha magazine on February 25.The manga previously inspired two live-action films, two live-action television series, and two live-action online series. The manga also inspired a stage play in 2023.Kaitani's ONE OUTS manga inspired a television anime in 2008. Source: Liar Game anime's X/Twitter account via Ota-Suke

title: Dr. Stone: Science Future Anime Previews Final Part's 1st Episode in Trailer
content: The staff for the third and final cours (quarter of a year) of Dr. Stone: Science Future, the fourth and final season of the Dr. Stone anime series, revealed a trailer on Sunday that previews the first episode (25th overall episode for the anime) titled "Future Engine." Image via Dr. Stone anime's X/Twitter account©米スタジオ・Boichi／集英社・Dr.STONE製作委員会The third part will debut on April 2 on Tokyo MX and other channels at 10:00 p.m. JST. title: Fate/Strange Fake Anime Teases 'To Be Continued' in Video

The first airing was for 90 minutes, airing both the Fate/strange Fake -Whispers of Dawn- special and then the first episode of the main television anime series.SawanoHiroyuki[nZk]:Jean-Ken Johnny & TAKUMA are performing the opening theme song "Provant." It began streaming the English dub of the anime in January 2026.Fate/strange Fake -Whispers of Dawn- directors Shun Enokido (Fate/Grand Order commercials, Flip Flappers episode director) and Takahito Sakazume (Fate/Grand Order commercials Fate/Apocrypha episode director) directed the Fate/strange Fake anime at A-1 Pictures. Narita then developed the story as a Fate/strange Fake supplement for the Type-Moon Ace Vol. 2 magazine, before launching a full-fledged light novel series with illustrations by Shizuki Morii in January 2015. Kadokawa 's Dengeki Bunko imprint published the ninth light novel volume in March 2024. Morii has also been simultaneously drawing a manga adaptation.

title: Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance Film's 4th Teaser Previews New Threat
content: The AnimeJapan 2026 stage panel for Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance (Heart's Resonance), the all-new feature-length anime film sequel to the Expelled from Paradise film, debuted the new film's fourth teaser trailer and fourth key visual on Sunday. The teaser introduces "Fallen," a mysterious entity threatening the space station DEVA: Image via Expelled from Paradise franchise's website©東映アニメーション・ニトロプラス／楽園追放ソサイエティ The cast members are: Ayane Sakura as Gabriel Saori Hayami as Alma Yoshino Aoyama as Danel Sally Amaki as Raguel The film reunites the main staff of Expelled from Paradise, including director Seiji Mizushima, scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus, character designer Masatsugu Saitō, and composer NARASAKI. Toei Animation is producing the animation. The other staff members include: Mechanical Designers: Kanetake Ebikawa, Junya Ishigaki, Takayuki Yanase Animation Supervisor: Naoki Ogita Modeling Supervisor: Kento Kume Mecha Modeling Lead: Toyokazu Hashimoto Producer: Kōichi Ioguchn The film will open in Japan on November 13. The franchise is also spawning a new game with an original story this winter.While the original announcement of the film had featured the title Rakuen Tsuihō: Liberated from Paradise, a later announcement listed the title as Rakuen Tsuihō -Expelled from Paradise- Kokoro no Resonance as well as Rakuen Tsuihō: Kokoro no Resonance instead.Image courtesy of Aniplex©東映アニメーション・ニトロプラス／楽園追放ソサイエティExpelled from Paradise debuted in 13 theaters in Japan in November 2014, and sold 110,000 tickets. The film's Blu-ray Disc and DVD release in Japan sold more than 70,000 copies. The film won the Best Animation of the Year Award at the 24th Japan Movie Critics Awards in May 2015. Aniplex of America released Expelled from Paradise in 15 theaters across the United States in December 2014. The company then released the film on Blu-ray Disc in North, Central, and South America in June 2015. The film returned to theaters in Japan in November 2024 in 4K resolution as Expelled from Paradise -Impelled by 10th Anniversary- to commemorate the film's 10-year anniversary.Source: Comic Natalie

title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc's 2nd Trailer Unveils 4 New Cast Members, October Debut
content: Pony Canyon's stage presentation at the AnimeJapan 2026 event on Sunday revealed the second trailer, additional cast members, and October debut for Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Arc (Tokyo Revengers: Santen Sensō-hen), the latest arc of the Tokyo Revengers anime. The newly announced cast are:Naoyuki Shimozuru as Takeomi Akashi, Brahman's No. 2 also known as "God of War"Image courtesy of Pony Canyon©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.Shinnosuke Tachibana as Wakasa Imaushi, a top executive of Brahman, nicknamed "Waka"Image courtesy of Pony Canyon©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.Takanori Hoshino as Keizo Arashi, a top executive of Brahman, nicknamed "Benkei"Image courtesy of Pony Canyon©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.Hiroki Yasumoto as South Terano, leader of Rokuhara Tandai, the largest gang based in Minato WardImage courtesy of Pony Canyon©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.Pony Canyon also announced that the Dōwa Revengers (Fairy Tale Revengers) mini anime will get a sequel titled Puchi Dōwa Revengers, and will reveal more details at a later date. The mini anime started streaming on Tokyo Revengers anime's official YouTube channel in October 2024, and added subtitles in November the same year.Image via Tokyo Revengers anime's X/Twitter account©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.Image courtesy of Pony Canyon©Ken Wakui, KODANSHA / TOKYO REVENGERS Anime Production Committee.The anime's staff previously announced that Mariya Ise will voice Senju Kawaragi.Pony Canyon describes the new arc's story:The conflict between Tokyo Manji Gang and Tenjiku came to a gruesome end. As each individual carries their sorrow and moves forward on their own path,Takemichi Hanagaki(TAKE‐MITCHY) finds himself in awe of the late Tetta Kisaki.Upon hearing the full truth behind the time leaps, Manjiro Sano (Mikey) makes a crucial decision.After leaving the past behind, Takemichi finally reaches the ultimate future where his beloved Hinata is alive. However, "he" is nowhere to be found.In the era of the “Three Titans,” where three teams battle for dominance, the final revenge begins!Maki Kodaira (The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse) is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS, replacing Kōichi Hatsumi from previous anime seasons. Hatsumi is now credited with collaborating on overseeing the series scripts. Airi Tsuyuki and Kae Takakura join previous character designers Keiko Ōta and Kenichi Ōnuki. (Tsuyuki and Takakura were animation directors previously in the anime.) Yoshitomo Hara joins Hideki Fukushima as bike and prop designer. Kōji Ietaka is the new compositing director of photography, replacing Hisayoshi Yamamoto from the previous season. LIDEN FILMS is credited for 3D CG work.Returning staff members include Yasuyuki Mutō in charge of series scripts, Rumi Matsumoto as art director, Kunio Tsujita as color key artist, Satoki Iida as sound director, and Hiroaki Tsutsumi as music composer.Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku Arc (Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku-hen), the third season of the anime adaptation of Ken Wakui's Tokyo Revengers manga, premiered in Japan in October 2023. Disney+ exclusively streamed the anime worldwide (except in Mainland China).Wakui launched the manga in Kodansha's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in March 2017, and ended the series in November 2022. Weekly Shōnen Magazine is serializing the Tokyo Revengers Extra spinoff manga about the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang.Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:Watching the news, Takemichi Hanagaki learns that his girlfriend from way back in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, has died. The only girlfriend he ever had was just killed by a villainous group known as the Tokyo Manji Gang. He lives in a crappy apartment with thin walls, and his six-years-younger boss treats him like an idiot. Plus, he's a complete and total virgin … At the height of his rock-bottom life, he suddenly time-leaps twelve years back to his middle school days!! To save Hinata, and change the life he spent running away, hopeless part-timer Takemichi must aim for the top of Kanto's most sinister delinquent gang!!The manga's first television anime adaptation premiered in April 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan. The anime's Tokyo Revengers: Christmas Showdown arc premiered in January 2023 and aired for 13 episodes. Disney+ and Hulu streamed the arc as it aired.The first live-action film based on the manga opened in Japan in July 2021 and was the #1 live-action film in Japan in 2021. Crunchyroll is streaming the film. The first of the two sequel live-action films Chi no Halloween -Unmei- (Bloody Halloween -Fate-) opened in Japan in April 2023, while the second film Chi no Halloween -Kessen- (Bloody Halloween -Decisive Battle-) opened in Japan in June 2023.Sources: AnimeJapan 2026 stage presentation, Press release

The newly announced cast are:
Naoyuki Shimozuru as Takeomi Akashi, Brahman's No. 2 also known as "God of War"
Shinnosuke Tachibana as Wakasa Imaushi, a top executive of Brahman, nicknamed "Waka"
Takanori Hoshino as Keizo Arashi, a top executive of Brahman, nicknamed "Benkei"
Hiroki Yasumoto as South Terano, leader of Rokuhara Tandai, the largest gang based in Minato Ward

Pony Canyon also announced that the Dōwa Revengers ( Fairy Tale Revengers ) mini anime will get a sequel titled Puchi Dōwa Revengers , and will reveal more details at a later date. The mini anime started streaming on Tokyo Revengers anime's official YouTube channel in October 2024, and added subtitles in November the same year.

contentBlocks.credit: Image via Tokyo Revengers anime's X/Twitter account

contentBlocks.text: Pony Canyon describes the new arc's story:

The conflict between Tokyo Manji Gang and Tenjiku came to a gruesome end. As each individual carries their sorrow and moves forward on their own path,Takemichi Hanagaki(TAKE‐MITCHY) finds himself in awe of the late Tetta Kisaki. Upon hearing the full truth behind the time leaps, Manjiro Sano (Mikey) makes a crucial decision. After leaving the past behind, Takemichi finally reaches the ultimate future where his beloved Hinata is alive. However, "he" is nowhere to be found. In the era of the “Three Titans,” where three teams battle for dominance, the final revenge begins!

Maki Kodaira ( The Seven Deadly Sins: Four Knights of the Apocalypse ) is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS , replacing Kōichi Hatsumi from previous anime seasons. Hatsumi is now credited with collaborating on overseeing the series scripts. Airi Tsuyuki and Kae Takakura join previous character designers Keiko Ōta and Kenichi Ōnuki . (Tsuyuki and Takakura were animation directors previously in the anime.) Yoshitomo Hara joins Hideki Fukushima as bike and prop designer. Kōji Ietaka is the new compositing director of photography, replacing Hisayoshi Yamamoto from the previous season. LIDEN FILMS is credited for 3D CG work.

Returning staff members include Yasuyuki Mutō in charge of series scripts, Rumi Matsumoto as art director, Kunio Tsujita as color key artist, Satoki Iida as sound director, and Hiroaki Tsutsumi as music composer.

Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku Arc ( Tokyo Revengers : Tenjiku-hen ), the third season of the anime adaptation of Ken Wakui 's Tokyo Revengers manga, premiered in Japan in October 2023. Disney+ exclusively streamed the anime worldwide (except in Mainland China).

Wakui launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in March 2017, and ended the series in November 2022. Weekly Shōnen Magazine is serializing the Tokyo Revengers Extra spinoff manga about the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang.
Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Watching the news, Takemichi Hanagaki learns that his girlfriend from way back in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, has died. The only girlfriend he ever had was just killed by a villainous group known as the Tokyo Manji Gang. He lives in a crappy apartment with thin walls, and his six-years-younger boss treats him like an idiot. Plus, he's a complete and total virgin … At the height of his rock-bottom life, he suddenly time-leaps twelve years back to his middle school days!! To save Hinata, and change the life he spent running away, hopeless part-timer Takemichi must aim for the top of Kanto's most sinister delinquent gang!!

The manga's first television anime adaptation premiered in April 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan. The anime's Tokyo Revengers: Christmas Showdown arc premiered in January 2023 and aired for 13 episodes. Disney+ and Hulu streamed the arc as it aired.

The first live-action film based on the manga opened in Japan in July 2021 and was the #1 live-action film in Japan in 2021. Crunchyroll is streaming the film. The first of the two sequel live-action films Chi no Halloween -Unmei- (Bloody Halloween -Fate-) opened in Japan in April 2023, while the second film Chi no Halloween -Kessen- (Bloody Halloween -Decisive Battle-) opened in Japan in June 2023.

title: '"Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu' Reveals Additional Cast Pair
content:
The "Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu ( The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me yet Showers Me with Adoration ) AnimeJapan 2026 special stage at the DMM TV booth revealed an additional cast pair on Sunday.

The anime adapting Kei Misawa and Natsu Mizuno 's fantasy romance manga will premiere on TV Asahi and BS Asahi in July 2026.

Voice actors Kaito Ishikawa ( Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon ) and Chika Anzai ( Jibaku Shounen Hanako-kun ) are joining the cast as Yarmo Pernila and Serafina Pernila, respectively.

Hitoyuki Matsui ( Karakuri Zoushi Ayatsuri Sakon ) is directing the anime at Zero-G and Grass . Tomoko Konparu ( Kimi ni Todoke ) is handling the series composition, and Yuuko Yahiro ( Kaguya-sama wa Kokurasetai: Tensai-tachi no Renai Zunousen ) is designing the characters. Michiru ( Given ) is composing the music.

Misawa and Mizuno began serializing the fantasy romance manga on the BookLive web service in February 2021. Flex Comix published the fifth volume on March 13. The manga is also available in English on the MangaPlaza web service. A novel adaptation launched on BookLive in October 2021.

title: Kadokawa Reveals Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi Anime Film's October 23 Opening
content: Kadokawa's stage presentation at the AnimeJapan 2026 event on Sunday revealed the key visual and October 23 premiere for Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi (Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery), the first film in the new Made in Abyss anime film trilogy. Image courtesy of Kadokawa©つくしあきひと・竹書房/劇場シリーズ「メイドインアビス」製作委員会In addition, Kadokawa announced that pre-registration for Made in Abyss: Doshigatai Fushigi na Tabi, the first smartphone game adaptation of Akihito Tsukushi's Made in Abyss manga, has started on March 28. Made in Abyss: Journey's Dawn will screen from May 22 to June 4, and Made in Abyss: Wandering Twilight will screen from May 29 to June 11.Image courtesy of Kadokawa© つくしあきひと・竹書房/劇場シリーズ「メイドインアビス」製作委員会The returning cast members for the Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi film include:Mariya Ise as RegMiyu Tomita as RikoShiori Izawa as NanachiMisaki Kuno as FaputaMasayuki Kojima (Black Bullet, Tibetan Dog) is returning to direct the anime at the studio Kinema Citrus (My Happy Marriage, The Rising of The Shield Hero). Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun ( Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ōgonkyō ) was the second season based on Akihito Tsukushi 's Made in Abyss manga . Sentai Filmworks licensed the second season for release on digital and home video.

One day, Riko starts exploring the caves and discovers a robot who resembles a human boy.

Crunchyroll added the earlier television anime to its catalog beginning in 2021, and it describes the anime:

Keroro is Sergeant Frog - the leader of a platoon of warriors sent to conquer planet Earth. But when the amphibious invaders discovered how much humans enjoy dissecting their comrades, the troops were scattered, the mission was aborted, and Keroro was abandoned. Now, this once proud soldier spends more time wielding a vacuum than he does the weapons of war. It's a far cry from the glory of battle, but hey, at least he's got his own room. And though the invasion may have slowed to a hop, Sergeant Frog still occasionally yearns to overcome his karaoke addiction and reassemble his troops.

Discotek licensed the anime, and its release of Sgt. Frog includes all 358 episodes in successive SD Blu-ray Disc volume releases by season, beginning in 2021. Discotek released seasons 5-7 last year.
American manga publisher Tokyopop released twenty volumes of the original manga in North America before shutting its doors in 2011.

title: 'Tokyo Revengers: Santen Sensou-hen' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo for Fall 2026
content:
The Pony Canyon booth at AnimeJapan 2026 revealed four additional cast and a second promotional video for Tokyo Revengers: Santen Sensou-hen ( Tokyo Revengers: Three Deities arc ) television anime on Sunday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in October 2026.

Cast Takeomi Akashi: Naoyuki Shimozuru ( Binan Koukou Chikyuu Bouei-bu Happy Kiss! ) Keizo Arashi: Takanori Hoshino ( Mob Psycho 100 II ) Wakasa Imaushi: Shinnosuke Tachibana ( Tokyo Ghoul ) Minami Terano: Hiroki Yasumoto ( One Punch Man )

Maki Kodaira ( Nanatsu no Taizai: Mokushiroku no Yonkishi ) is directing the new season at LIDENFILMS . Yasuyuki Mutou ( Deadman Wonderland ) is handling the series composition. Kenichi Oonuki ( Golden Kamuy ), Keiko Oota ( Gyakuten Saiban: Sono "Shinjitsu", Igi Ari! ), and Airi Tsuyuki ( Ookami to Koushinryou: Merchant Meets the Wise Wolf chief animation director) are designing the characters. Hiroaki Tsutsumi ( Dr. Stone ) is composing the music.

The anime adapts Ken Wakui 's delinquent action manga , which ran in Weekly Shounen Magazine from March 2017 to November 2022. Kodansha published the 31st and final volume in January 2023.

Kodansha USA began releasing the manga digitally in English in 2018. The 31th and final volume went on sale in June 2023. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English for physical release in November 2021. The 15th and final omnibus volume is scheduled to be released on March 25.

title: 'Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon no Taki-hen' Announces Additional Cast Pair for Fall 2026
content:
The Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon no Taki-hen ( Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc ) AnimeJapan 2026 stage event at the Pony Canyon booth announced an additional cast pair on Sunday. The second season adapting Yura Urushibara 's action fantasy manga will air on Nippon Television beginning in October 2026.

Voice actors Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Kimetsu no Yaiba ) and Kent Itou ( [Oshi no Ko] ) are joining the cast as Hagure Nekosaki and Yuu Innami, respectively.

Ato Nonaka ( Fate/Zero episode director) is returning to direct at Studio Hibari . Yukie Sugawara ( Overlord ) is handling series composition and script. Ryouko Amisaki ( Radiant 2nd Season ) is designing the characters and Kohta Yamamoto ( Mato Seihei no Slave ) is composing the music.

Produced by Studio Hibari, the first season aired in 24 episodes from Summer 2025 to Fall 2025. Crunchyroll and Netflix simulcasted the anime with subtitles in multiple languages.

Urushibara began serializing the manga in Weekly Shounen Champion in June 2020. Akita Shoten published the 28th volume on February 6, with the 29th volume scheduled to be released on Apri 8. Tougen Anki has a cumulative 5.5 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in March 2024 and published the fourth volume in November 2025, with the fifth volume planned for a May 26 release.

title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Anime's 2nd Season Video Unveils New Visual
content: NBC Universal unveiled a new video and visual for the second season of hte television anime of Masakuni Igarashi's Tune In to the Midnight Heart (Mayonaka Heart Tune) manga during a panel for the anime on Sunday. Image courtesy of NBC Universal© 五十嵐正邦・講談社 Image via Tune Into the Midnight Heart anime's website©五十嵐正邦・講談社／「真夜中ハートチューン」製作委員会 The first season premiered on January 6, and aired on Kansai TV and Fuji TV's newly announced "Ka-Anival!!" programming block that airs on Tuesdays at 11:00 p.m. JST. The anime also aired on BS Asahi starting on January 9. The anime's 12th and final episode aired on March 24. Crunchyroll streamed the anime, and it also streamed an English dub. Masayuki Takahashi (Butareba: The Story of a Man Turned into a Pig) directed the anime at Gekkō, and Yukie Sugawara (Overlord) was in charge of series scripts. Tomoyuki Shitaya (Food Wars! Shokugeki no Soma, Bakuman.) designed the characters. Suisei Hoshimachi performs the opening theme song "Tsuki ni Mukatte Ute" (Attack Toward the Moon), and Soala performs the ending theme song "Koe no Kiseki" (Trails of Voices). Kodansha's K MANGA service is publishing the manga digitally in English, and it describes the story: When Arisu Yamabuki was all alone in bed at night, he was able to find solace in the voice of a radio host who went by “Apollo.” However, one day, she simply stopped broadcasting without any explanation. Years then passed, and Arisu is now a second-year high-schooler. He makes it his mission to search for Apollo, as there is something he wants to tell her. He doesn't know what she looks like, or even what her real name is, but he manages to get some leads on her in his school's broadcasting club. That's where he meets four girls who all dream to get a job where they can make full use of their voices! Just who is Apollo, and how will those four's dreams pan out? Igarashi (Senryū Girl, Detectives These Days Are Crazy!) launched the manga in Kodansha's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in September 2023. The 12th compiled book volume shipped on March 17. Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga and released the sixth volume on March 10.Source: Press release

That's where he meets four girls who all dream to get a job where they can make full use of their voices! Just who is Apollo, and how will those four's dreams pan out?

Igarashi ( Senryū Girl , Detectives These Days Are Crazy! ) launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in September 2023. The 12th compiled book volume shipped on March 17. Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga and released the sixth volume on March 10.

Under orders from the military, Kodō travels around the country to investigate supernatural phenomena. In one town where it is rumored that "black snow" falls, he meets a boy who thinks his mysterious powers are an illness. Kodō shows the boy how to use his powers, and offers him a letter of recommendation to Seihō Middle School. As he travels to other areas, Kodō encounters many other mysterious events.

Shiibashi launched the manga in Shueisha 's Ultra Jump magazine in February 2021, after publishing a one-shot pilot in Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ app in March 2020. Shueisha published the 13th compiled volume on January 19.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream Reveals Rio Futaba Memorial Visual
content:
Ahead of the Rascal Does Not Dream anime conclusion with the upcoming Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend movie, the series will release a memorial visual featuring the heroines of the series. First up is a memorial visual of Rio Futaba.

A video that features the real-life location in the visual was also released:

Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend anime movie is set to premiere on October 16 in Japan. The movie marks the anime’s conclusion. The voice cast includes:

• Asami Seto as Mai Sakurajima

• Kaito Ishikawa as Sakuta Azusagawa

• Reina Ueda as Mini-Skirt Santa

• Yurika Kubo as Kaede Azusagawa

• Nao Toyama as Tomoe Koga

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Rio Futaba

• Maaya Uchida as Nodoka Toyohama

• Inori Minase as Shoko Makinohara

• Sora Amamiya as Uzuki Hirokawa

• Aya Yamane as Ikumi Akagi

• Konomi Kohara as Sara Himeji

• Manaka Iwami as Miori ‌Mito

The Rascal Does Not Dream light novel series was written by Hajime Kamoshida, while Keji Mizoguchi drew the illustrations for it. ASCII Media Works began publishing it under their Dengeki Bunko imprint in April 2014, releasing a total of 15 volumes. The final volume was released on October 10, 2024, marking the end of the novel after 10 years of serialization.

title: Straw Hats Are Off to Elbaph in One Piece Episode 1156 Preview Trailer
content:
ONE PIECE revealed the preview for Episode 1156, finally heading the Straw Hats to the long-awaited Elbaph. The anime is coming back after a 3-month break next week.

Episode 1156’s title is “The Long-sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet,” and you can watch the preview trailer below.

The ONE PIECE manga by Eiichiro Oda first began in July 1997, and the series exceeded 500 million circulating copies worldwide in August 2022. It also celebrated the 25th anniversary in 2022, while the anime adaptation started in October 1999 and is also still going strong. As Elbaph Arc got closer, hype was built with new cast additions . It culminated in Yuichi Nakamura getting cast as Loki , probably the most exciting character to make his debut in years and guaranteed to play a huge role in the endgame.

The anime will also be debuting new theme songs. The opening song’s title is “Luminous,” and it’s performed by AiNA THE END. The ending song will be “That Future” by Jisoku 36km.

Upcoming Projects

• Netflix’s live-action series has Season 3 already confirmed

• The franchise also has the upcoming remake anime by WIT Studio

• One Piece: Heroines novel focused on the female characters is getting an anime

title: Sound! Euphonium The Final Movie Reveals Stage Greeting Event, OST CD Covers
content:
Sound! Euphonium The Final Movie Part 1 stage greeting event has been revealed along with the CD cover jacket of the movie’s theme song “ToCoda” by TRUE and the original soundtrack “Melody across the Seasons.” Kyoto Animation is animating the movie, set to release on April 24.

AnimeJapan 2026 All Announcements and Highlights

The dates for the stage greeting events are as follows:

• April 24 (Fri) – Premiere Stage Greeting (at Marunouchi Piccadilly)

• April 25 (Sat) – Stage Greeting ~Tokyo Edition~ (at Shinjuku Piccadilly)

• April 26 (Sun) – Stage Greeting ~Kanagawa Edition~ (at Yokohama Burg 13/Kawasaki Cinecitta)

• May 2 (Sat) – Stage Greeting ~Nagoya Edition~ (at Midland Square Cinema/109 Cinemas Nagoya)

• May 3 (Sun) – Stage Greeting ~Osaka/Kyoto Edition~ (Namba Parks Cinema/MOVIX Kyoto)

• May 4 (Mon) – It’s Greenery Day Stage Greeting (Shinjuku Piccadilly)

Taichi Ogawa is directing and Tatsuya Ishihara is the chief director. Jukki Hanada is writing the script and series composition, and Shoko Ikeda and Kazumi Ikeda are handling the character designs. Akito Matsuda is composing the music. TRUE is singing the theme song“ToCoda.” The first season of the anime premiered in 2015, while the second season debuted in 2016, and the third season was broadcast in 2024, concluding in June of that year . There were also two movies between the first and second TV anime seasons— Sound Euphonium: Our Promise: A Brand New Day (2019) and Sound Euphonium: Ensemble Contest Arc (2023).

The cast includes:

• Tomoyo Kurosawa as Kumiko Oumae

• Chika Anzai as Reina Kosaka

• Ayaka Asai as Hazuki Kato

• Moe Toyota as Sapphire Kawashima

• Haruka Tomatsu as Mayu Kuroe

• Takahiro Sakurai as Noboru Taki

Crunchyroll is streaming all three seasons of the series, describing it as follows: Spring in the first year of high school. Kumiko, a member of the brass band in junior high school, visits the high school brass band club with classmates Hazuki and Sapphire. There, she comes across Reina, her former classmate from junior high. Hazuki and Sapphire decide to join the club, but Kumiko can’t make up her mind. She recollects her experience with Reina at a competition in junior high school.

title: Tune In to the Midnight Heart Season 2 Reveals Teaser Visual, Trailer
content:
The previously announced Tune In to the Midnight Heart Season 2 revealed a teaser visual and trailer at AnimeJapan 2026. The release date of the sequel is yet to be announced.

Studio Gekko animated the first season and Masayuki Takahashi is the director. Yukie Sugawara wrote the script and Tomoyuki Shitaya designed the characters.

Suisei Hoshimachi is singing the opening theme song “Tsuki ni Mukatte Ute,” and Soala performs the ending theme song “Koe no Kiseki.” The main cast includes:

• Rumi Okubo as Nene Himekawa

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Kirino Iko

• Miku Ito as Shinobu Uzuki

• Rikuya Yasuda as Arisu Yamabuki

Tune In to the Midnight Heart anime is based on a manga series written by Masakuni Igarashi. It is available in English simultaneously through Kodansha’s K Manga digital platform. It describes the story: When Arisu Yamabuki was all alone in bed at night, he was able to find solace in the voice of a radio host who went by “Apollo.” However, one day, she simply stopped broadcasting without any explanation.Years then passed, and Arisu is now a second-year high-schooler. He makes it his mission to search for Apollo, as there is something he wants to tell her. He doesn’t know what she looks like, or even what her real name is, but he manages to get some leads on her in his school’s broadcasting club. That’s where he meets four girls who all dream to get a job where they can make full use of their voices!Just who is Apollo, and how will those four’s dreams pan out?

title: Expelled from Paradise: Resonance Anime Movie Reveals Key Visual, Teaser Trailer
content:
The previously announced Expelled from Paradise: Resonance anime movie revealed a key visual and teaser trailer at AnimeJapan 2026. Toei Animation is animating the series.

See more AnimeJapan 2026 updates: AnimeJapan 2026 All Announcements and Highlights

Seiji Mizushima is directing the film and Gen Urobuchi (NITROPLUS) is in charge of the screenplay. Masatsugu Saito is providing the character designs, with the mechanical designs done by Kanetake Ebikawa, Junya Ishigaki and Takayuki Yanase. NARASAKI is composing the music. The main cast includes:

• Ayane Sakura as Gabriel

• Saori Hayami as Arma

• Yoshino Aoyama as Daniel

• Sally Amaki as Raguel

Aniplex of USA has licensed the original Expelled from Paradise movie for its North American theatrical release, as well as for its Blu-Ray/DVD release. They describe the plot as follows: With Earth now left in ruins following the “Nano Hazard,” most of humanity has abandoned the planet they once called home along with their physical bodies and rebuilt their digitalized minds into a society within the cyber universe of “DEVA.” A.D. 2400, DEVA’s central council detects an incident of unauthorized access into their mainframe. Someone on Earth was trying to hack into the system. The only information DEVA was able to retrieve was that the hacker referred to themselves as “Frontier Setter.” To investigate the mysterious hacker’s motives, the high officials of DEVA dispatch System Security Third Officer Angela Balzac to the Earth’s surface. Equipped with a prosthetic “material body,” Angela attempts to make contact with a local agent Dingo, but what awaited her instead was a swarm of Sandworms now infesting the Earth’s surface. Angela intercepts the gruesome pests with her exoskeletal powered suit Arhan. Will Angela and Dingo be able to find Frontier Setter on this devastated planet? Their journey to explore the secrets of the world will begin now…!

content:
Let’s Go Kaikigumi released a new trailer along with a July 5 premiere date. The trailer was first shown at this year’s AnimeJapan 2026 event. Additionally, Mayumi Shintani joins the cast as Cursed Doll.

• Yoshino Aoyama as Shurako

title: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Anime Reveals New Key Visual, October 23 Premiere
content:
Made in Abyss anime revealed a new key visual for Part 1 of its theatrical film series, Awakening Mystery . The first installment is set to premiere in Japan on October 23, 2026.

It was also announced that ahead of the new film series, previous Made in Abyss recap movies and entries will receive theatrical re-screenings in Japan. This includes the compilation films Journey’s Dawn and Wandering Twilight , along with Dawn of the Deep Soul and the TV anime sequel The Golden City of the Scorching Sun .

You can see the new visual below.

The anime movie previously revealed a teaser visual , featuring two new characters, Tepaste and Cravagli, shown at the Tumble Tavern. The new film will serve as a direct continuation of the 2022 TV anime Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun . Kinema Citrus returns as the animation studio, continuing its involvement from the previous entries in the series. The staff includes:

• Director: Masayuki Kojima

• Screenplay: Hideyuki Kurata

• Character Design: Yuka Kuroda, Kazuchika Kise (Production I.G)

• Animation Production: Kinema Citrus

The confirmed voice cast includes:

• Miyu Tomita as Riko

• Mariya Ise as Reg

• Shiori Izawa as Nanachi

• Misaki Kuno as Faputa

You can watch the first trailer below.

Made in Abyss , written and illustrated by Akihito Tsukushi, follows the descent of a girl named Riko and a robot boy named Reg into the Abyss, a massive pit filled with ancient relics and mysterious creatures. The manga is serialized on Takeshobo’s Web Comic Gamma and has over 22 million circulating copies.

A film concert titled Made in Abyss Film Concert: Deep Echoes of Resonance was held today on February 8, 2026 at Tokyo’s Nakano ZERO Grand Hall. Composer Kevin Penkin conducted a live orchestra performing the anime’s soundtrack, accompanied by anime footage on a large screen. Vocalist Ko Saito and KIHOW (MYTH & ROID), who performed the series’ theme songs, also appeared for live performances. Main cast members Miyu Tomita (Riko), Mariya Ise (Reg), and Shiori Izawa (Nanachi) were also present.

You can watch the first trailer below.

Made in Abyss , written and illustrated by Akihito Tsukushi, follows the descent of a girl named Riko and a robot boy named Reg into the Abyss, a massive pit filled with ancient relics and mysterious creatures. The manga is serialized on Takeshobo’s Web Comic Gamma and has over 22 million circulating copies.

A film concert titled Made in Abyss Film Concert: Deep Echoes of Resonance was held today on February 8, 2026 at Tokyo’s Nakano ZERO Grand Hall. Composer Kevin Penkin conducted a live orchestra performing the anime’s soundtrack, accompanied by anime footage on a large screen. Vocalist Ko Saito and KIHOW (MYTH & ROID), who performed the series’ theme songs, also appeared for live performances. Main cast members Miyu Tomita (Riko), Mariya Ise (Reg), and Shiori Izawa (Nanachi) were also present.

content:
Dr. Stone: Science Future (Season 4) Cour 3 (final) revealed the preview images and trailer for Episode 1 (Episode 25 of the season). The episode is titled “Future Engine,” and it’s scheduled for an April 2 premiere date .

You can watch the preview trailer below.

The story follows a genius scientist, Senku Ishigami, as the he attempts to revive humanity after everyone gets mysteriously petrified. Having slowly achieved remarkable progress, their goal is now space, but Dr. Xeno proved to be a new challenge along with Stanley Snyder. They eventually joined the Kingdom Science, and now it’s time to learn the secret behind Why-Man.

The first season of the Dr. Stone anime adaptation began airing in the Summer of 2019 anime season and had 24 episodes. The second season, Dr. Stone: Stone Wars , started in January 2021 and ran for 11 episodes. The series also received a special episode focusing on Ryusui in July 2022. The third, Stone: New World , ran for 23 episodes over 2 split cours in 2023. The fourth season was announced as the final one immediately after the finale of Season 3.

title: 'Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content:
The Nijusseiki Denki Mokuroku ( Sparks of Tomorrow ) Blue Stage revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, second key visual (pictured), and a second promotional video on Sunday. The anime, adapting Hiro Yuuki 's historical romance light novel , is scheduled to premiere on July 5 at 11:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11, ABC TV, and TV Aichi.

Cast Suzu Harashima: You Taichi ( Majo to Yajuu ) Kate Ookura: Natsumi Kawaida ( Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. ) Yajirou Yagura: Kazuki Ura ( Gachiakuta ) Izou Masubushi: Daisuke Hirakawa ( Kimetsu no Yaiba )

Staff Art Director: Mao Takayama ( Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S background art) Color Design: Fuyuki Ootsuka Prop Design: Aya Hikita ( Hibike! Euphonium 3 key animation) Director of Photography: Kouki Ueda ( City The Animation ) 3D Director: Mitsuki Takaki Sound Director: Youta Tsuruoka ( Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden ) Music Production: Lantis , Heart Company

Singer-songwriter Luna Goami ( Shuumatsu Touring ending theme) is performing the opening theme "Eureka Evrika," which is previewed in the promotional video below. American singer-songwriter Ginger Root performs the ending theme.

Minoru Oota ( Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon S episode director) is helming the anime at Kyoto Animation . Tatsuhiko Urahata ( Ookami to Koushinryou: Merchant Meets the Wise Wolf ) is handling the series composition. Kouhei Okamura ( Free! Movie: The Final Stroke ) is designing the characters and serving as chief animation director, while Takaaki Suzuki ( Violet Evergarden ) is in charge of world design. Hitomi Koto is composing the music.

The light novel won Honorable Mention at the 8th Kyoto Animation Award in 2017. Yuuki published the title under Kyoto Animation KA Esuma Bunko label with illustrations by Kazumi Ikeda ( Hibike! Euphonium 3 character design) in August 2018.

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Film's Teaser Reveals October 16 Release Date
content: Aniplex unveiled a new teaser trailer for Seishun Buta Yarō wa Dear Friend no Yume o Minai (Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend) film, the latest anime adaptation of Hajime Kamoshida's Rascal Does Not Dream (Seishun Buta Yarō or Aobuta) novel series, during its stage event for the film at AnimeJapan 2026 on Sunday. The teaser reveals the film's October 16 date. Image courtesy of Aniplex©2025 鴨志田 一/KADOKAWA/青ブタ ProjectAniplex also revealed a new version of the film's previously unveiled visual (shown right) which contains the release date.The film's returning cast includes:Kaito Ishikawa as Sakuta AzusagawaAsami Seto as Mai SakurajimaSora Amamiya as Uzuki HirokawaAya Yamane as Ikumi AkagiKonomi Kohara as Sara HimejiManaka Iwami as Miori MitōReina Ueda as Nene IwamizawaNao Tōyama as Tomoe KogaAtsumi Tanezaki as Rio FutabaMaaya Uchida as Nodoka ToyohamaYurika Kubo as Kaede AzusagawaInori Minase as Shōko MakinoharaSōichi Masui returns to direct the film at CloverWorks. Masahiro Yokotani is also back to oversee and write the script, and Satomi Tamura is again designing the characters. The band fox capture plan also returns to compose the music. Aniplex is once again distributing the film. The new film is teased as taking the story towards its finale. (The film shares the same name as the 15th and final novel volume.)Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai (Seishun Buta Yarō wa Bunny Girl-senpai no Yume wo Minai), the first television anime based on the light novel series, premiered in Japan in October 2018 and aired for 13 episodes. The anime adapts the story up to the fifth novel volume. Aniplex of America streamed the series on Crunchyroll, Funimation, and other services.Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl (Seishun Buta Yarō wa Yume-Miru Shōjo no Yume wo Minai), the anime film that adapts the the sixth and seventh light novel volumes in the franchise, opened in Japan in June 2019. Aniplex of America and Funimation Films screened the anime in the United States. Crunchyroll began streaming the film on June 19 with both English subtitles and dub.The first film Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Venturing Out opened in Japan in June 2023. The film sold 118,108 tickets in its first three days and earned 175,648,924 yen (about US$1.28 million) to rank #4 in its opening weekend. Rascal Does Not Dream of a Knapsack Kid, the second film, opened in Japan in December 2023, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 119,000 tickets and earned 164,594,554 yen (about US$1.11 million) in its first three days.Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus (Seishun Buta Yarō wa Santa Claus no Yume wo Minai), the television anime adapting the light novel series' "University Student Arc," premiered on July 5. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and is also streaming an English dub.The original novel series has over 3 million copies in circulation. The Yen On imprint of Yen Press publishes the novel series, and Yen Press publishes Tsugumi Nanamiya's manga adaptation. Yen On will publish the Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend novel volume on January 6.Sources: AnimeJapan 2026 panel, press release, Disclosure: Kadokawa World Entertainment (KWE), a wholly owned subsidiary of Kadokawa Corporation, is the majority owner of Anime News Network, LLC. Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl ( Seishun Buta Yarō wa Yume-Miru Shōjo no Yume wo Minai ), the anime film that adapts the the sixth and seventh light novel volumes in the franchise , opened in Japan in June 2019. Aniplex of America and Funimation Films screened the anime in the United States. Crunchyroll began streaming the film on June 19 with both English subtitles and dub .

The first film Rascal Does Not Dream of a Sister Venturing Out opened in Japan in June 2023. The film sold 118,108 tickets in its first three days and earned 175,648,924 yen (about US$1.28 million) to rank #4 in its opening weekend. Rascal Does Not Dream of a Knapsack Kid , the second film, opened in Japan in December 2023, and ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 119,000 tickets and earned 164,594,554 yen (about US$1.11 million) in its first three days.

Rascal Does Not Dream of Santa Claus ( Seishun Buta Yarō wa Santa Claus no Yume wo Minai ), the television anime adapting the light novel series' "University Student Arc," premiered on July 5. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and is also streaming an English dub .

The original novel series has over 3 million copies in circulation. The Yen On imprint of Yen Press publishes the novel series, and Yen Press publishes Tsugumi Nanamiya 's manga adaptation. Yen On will publish the Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend novel volume on January 6.

title: 'Gensou Suikoden' Announces Supporting Cast
content:
The Gensou Suikoden ( Suikoden: The Anime ) White Stage at AnimeJapan 2026 revealed supporting cast members and a fourth key visual (pictured) on Sunday. The anime series adapting Konami's fantasy role-playing game will begin airing in October 2026.

Cast Culgan: Jun Kasama ( Revenger ) Seed: Yoshitsugu Matsuoka ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) Leknaat: Megumi Han ( Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari ) Gengen: Shouta Hayama ( Tokyo Revengers ) Rikimaru: Ryuunosuke Watanuki ( Blue Lock ) Rina: Saya Hitomi ( Chi. Chikyuu no Undou ni Tsuite ) Eilie: Umino Mizutama Bolgan: Yuusuke Sasaki ( Dandadan )

Yuuzou Satou ( Exception ) is helming the anime at Konami animation . Michihiro Tsuchiya ( Major 2nd 2nd Season ) is handling the series composition and Ryou Yamauchi ( Uchi no Shishou wa Shippo ga Nai ) is designing the characters. Kouji Nakamura ( Eureka Seven AO ) is composing the music.

The Suikoden franchise debuted in 1995 on the PlayStation, drawing inspiration from the classic Chinese novel Shui Hu Zhuan ( Water Margin ). Konami released Gensou Suikoden II ( Suikoden II ) in December 1998, followed by three more games in the main series in July 2002, August 2004, and February 2006 as well as multiple spin-offs.

Shinjirou Hori penned a light novel adaptation under Kadokawa's Dengeki Bunko imprint with illustrations by Fumi Ishikawa from December 2000 to September 2001.

Seven Seas licensed and releases both the original novels and the manga adaptation. The company describes the story:

"I will become the world's most wonderful maid!" With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count's family in the kingdom of Théolas. When she makes it, even cheap tea turns into a luxury brew, and a dilapidated mansion is quickly restored to new! Cleaning, serving, hunting, DIY—leave it all to her and her powerful magic. Unbeknownst to Melody, this world is actually an otome game, and she is the most powerful and invincible heroine, the saint! Yet, she remains oblivious to this fact. Romance with handsome men? Attacks by the Demon Lord? Work comes first! A fantasy of misunderstood work that unknowingly shatters destiny!

Atekichi launched the ongoing light novel series on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" website in February 2017. TO Books started publishing the novels with illustration by Yukiko in March 2020. Keiko launched the manga adaptation of the series on TO Books ' Corona EX website in March 2022. The light novels' ninth volume will ship on April 1. The manga's seventh volume will ship on July 1.

title: 'Baki-dou' Second Part Announced
content:
The Baki-dou Blue Stage at AnimeJapan 2026 announced a second part on Sunday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured) and teaser promotional video. The second part will be released worldwide exclusively on Netflix.

TMS Entertainment adapted the Hanma Baki prequel manga into two anime seasons on Netflix—the first season debuted with 12 episodes in September 2021 and the second season streamed in 27 episodes from July to August in 2023.

A crossover anime movie between the Hanma Baki and Kengan Ashura anime premiered worldwide on Netflix in June 2024. The first part of Baki-dou premiered on Netflix on February 26.

Keisuke Itagaki began serializing Baki-dou , the fourth main entry in the martial arts manga series, in Shounen Champion in March 2014 and ended it in April 2018.

A sequel manga, also titled Baki-dou ( Baki-dou 2 ), ran in the same magazine from October 2018 to June 2023, followed by Baki Rahen , which began in August 2023. The sixth volume was published on February 6.

title: 'Isekai Nonbiri Nouka 2' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo
content:
• The Isekai Nonbiri Nouka 2 ( Farming Life in Another World Season 2 ) AnimeJapan 2026 stage event at the Pony Canyon booth revealed additional cast, a key visual (pictured right), and a second promotional video on Sunday. The second season adapting Kinosuke Naitou 's fantasy slice of life light novel will air at 10.30 p.m. on AT-X followed by, TV Tokyo, BS TV Tokyo, and Tulip TV on April 6.

Cast Majin (The Demon God): Hikaru Midorikawa ( Black Clover ) Jack: Rikuya Yasuda ( Beelzebub-jou no Okinimesu mama. ) Morte: Eri Yukimura ( Blue Lock ) Bell Forgma: Mariko Honda ( Kami no Tou ) Gou Forgma: Yasuhiro Mamiya ( Vigilante: Boku no Hero Academia Illegals ) Kuzden: Fumiya Imai ( Given )

Ryouichi Kuraya ( Tsugumomo ) is directing the anime and handling the series composition and script at Zero-G . Yoshiko Saitou ( Kubo-san wa Mob wo Yurusanai ) is designing the characters, with Johannes Nilsson ( Kaifuku Jutsushi no Yarinaoshi ) (Team-MAX) and Yasuharu Takanashi ( Tsuki ga Michibiku Isekai Douchuu ) (Team-MAX) composing the music.

Produced by Zero-G, the first season aired in Winter 2023. HIDIVE streamed the anime with subtitles and an English dub.

Naitou began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in December 2016. Kadokawa began publishing the novel with illustrations by Yasumo in October 2017 and released the 20th volume on February 28. Isekai Nonbiri Nouka has a cumulative 5.7 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Yasuyuki Tsurugi began drawing a manga adaptation on the ComicWalker website in October 2017. Kadokawa published the 16th volume on March 9.

One Peace Books licensed the manga in English in September 2020 and published the 11th volume in November 2025, with the 12th scheduled to be released on June 23.

content:
The Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Hokori)! ( Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)! ) AnimeJapan 2026 stage event at the d Anime Store booth revealed the production staff, additional cast and a teaser promotional video on Sunday.

Produced by EMT Squared , the anime series adapting Atekichi 's isekai fantasy light novel air on Tokyo MX and BS Fuji beginning in July 2026.

Voice actress Youko Hikasa ( Summertime Render ) is joining the cast as Anne-Marie Victilium.

Staff Chief Director: Shinji Ishihira ( Edens Zero ) Director: Naoya Murakawa ( Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou sareta Beast Tamer, Saikyoushu no Nekomimi Shoujo to Deau episode director) Series Composition: Toshizou Nemoto ( Log Horizon ) Character Design: Eri Tokugawa ( Tensei Kizoku no Isekai Boukenroku: Jichou wo Shiranai Kamigami no Shito ) Sub-character Design: Eri Kojima ( Kami-tachi ni Hirowareta Otoko ) Art Director: Minoru Ookouchi ( Potion-danomi de Ikinobimasu! ) Color Design: Mika Iwami ( Kuma Kuma Kuma Bear ) Director of Photography: Atsushi Iwasaki ( Fairy Tail ) Editing: Honami Yamagishi ( Lv2 kara Cheat datta Motoyuusha Kouho no Mattari Isekai Life ) Music: Ken Itou ( 100-man no Inochi no Ue ni Ore wa Tatteiru ) Music Production: Lantis Sound Director: Hiroto Morishita ( Seirei Gensouki ) Sound Production: DAX Production

Atekichi began penning the novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in February 2017. TO Books began publishing the series with illustrations by Yukiko in March 2020. Yoshiko Saitou ( Towa no Yuugure ) and Yuuta Ootaka ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 3rd Season animation director) is designing the characters. KOHTA YAMAMOTO ( Dark Gathering ) is composing the music.

Ariyama originally began penning the action fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in August 2019. Shogakukan began printing the title under its Gagaga Books label in June 2020, featuring illustrations by Kodama . The sixth volume shipped in November 2025.
Ryou Kamito began drawing a manga adaptation on the Manga Doa app in April 2021. Mag Garden released the fifth volume in November 2025.
Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English in March 2025. The first volume was published on January 13, with the second volume scheduled for release on April 27.

title: 'Youchien Wars' Unveils Additional Cast, Studio, Teaser Promo for Spring 2027
content:
The Youchien Wars ( Kindergarten Wars ) White Stage at AnimeJapan 2026 revealed additional cast, studio, an updated teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Sunday. The anime series adapting You Chiba 's action comedy manga will air in Spring 2027.

Cast Hana Bradley: Hitomi Oowada ( Hanebado! ) Luke Smith: Satoshi Hino ( Maou 2099 ) Silvia Scott: Mariya Ise ( Chainsaw Man )

Shinsuke Gomi ( Silent Witch episode director) is helming the anime at Sunrise and Felix Film NEW . Junko Yamanaka ( Servamp ) is designing the characters.

Chiba began serializing the manga on the Shounen Jump+ web magazine in September 2022. Shueisha published the 16th volume on January 5, with the 17th volume planned for an April 3 release.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in October 2024 and released the third volume on January 20, with the fourth volume going on sale on April 28. Shueisha's Manga Plus platform also simulpublishes it in English, Spanish, Thai, and French.

title: 'One Piece: Heroines' Unveils Cast Pair, Promo
content:
The One Piece Red Stage event at AnimeJapan 2026 unveiled a cast pair and a promotional video for One Piece: Heroines anime on Saturday. The anime adapting Jun Esaka 's adventure fantasy light novel will premiere at 11.15 a.m. on July 5.

Voice actors Takehito Koyasu ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) and Maaya Sakamoto ( Enen no Shouboutai ) are joining the cast as Lubno and Miucca, respectively.

Haruka Kamatani ( Majo Minarai wo Sagashite ) is helming the anime, with Momoka Toyoda ( One Piece Fan Letter ) writing the script. Takashi Kojima ( Kimi to Nami ni Noretara ) is designing the characters.

Esaka penned the adventure fantasy light novel with illustration by Sayaka Suwa in One Piece Magazine from December 2019 to September 2023. Shueisha published the second and final volume in March 2024.

VIZ Media licensed the novel for English release in May 2024, and published the second volume in July 2025.

title: 'Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo 3rd Season' Announces Additional Cast
content:
• The Tokyo MX Booth at AnimeJapan 2026 announced an additional cast pair for Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo 3rd Season ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You Season 3 ) on Saturday. The new season is scheduled to premiere in July 2026.

Voice actresses Kaori Ishihara ( Hige wo Soru. Soshite Joshikousei wo Hirou. ) and Ayana Taketatsu ( Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e ) are joining the cast as Chiyo Iin and Nadeshiko Yamato, respectively.

Produced by Bibury Animation Studios , the first season aired in 12 episodes in Fall 2023. The second season premiered in Winter 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subtitles and dubs in multiple languages.

Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo , also known as Hyakkano , adapts Rikito Nakamura and Yukiko Nozawa 's comedy harem manga , which they launched in Young Jump magazine in December 2019. Shueisha published the 25th volume on March 18. Hyakkano has a cumulative 2.2 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English under its Ghost Ship imprint in July 2021. The 17th volume went on sale on March 17, with the 18th volume scheduled for a June 23 release.

title: 'Magic Knight Rayearth' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo for Fall 2026
content:
The Magic Knight Rayearth ( Mahou Kishi Rayearth ) Red Stage at AnimeJapan 2026 revealed the main cast, staff, teaser promotional video, and a key visual (pictured) on Saturday. The anime adapting CLAMP 's mahou shoujo manga is scheduled to premiere on TV Asahi's "IMAnimation W" frame at 11.45 p.m. in October 2026.

Cast Hikaru Shidou: Ayane Sakura ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu ) Fuu Hououji: Rie Takahashi ( [Oshi no Ko] ) Umi Ryuuzaki: Rumi Ookubo ( Mayonaka Heart Tune )

Staff Director: Yui Umemoto ( Ninja Kamui ) Series Composition: Shigeru Murakoshi ( Apocalypse Hotel ) Character Design: Satomi Watanabe ( Aikatsu! ) Music: Yuki Kajiura ( Mahou Shoujo Madoka★Magica ), Takumi Ozawa ( Magia Record: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica Gaiden ), Shiho Terada ( Inazuma Eleven Go ) Planning, Production: Unlimited Produce by TMS Studio: E&H Production

CLAMP serialized the manga in Nakayoshi magazine from November 1993 to February 1995. A sequel manga began in the same month and ended in March 1996.

Tokyopop licensed both manga in 1997, followed by Dark Horse Comics in 2009, and then Kodansha USA in 2019 with two hard-cover box sets containing three volumes each.
